_comment: Removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability: the card has no intimidate text. The generator hallucinated it from Blade Break equipment (27 cards corpus-wide). Repaired invalid condition types exposed when OR/AND stopped silently swallowing sub-conditions authored under "conditions": dropped ON_PLAY_ACTIVATE_ATTACK: a TRIGGER name used as a condition; it is not a condition. Repaired: the conditions list held a TRIGGER (ON_ACTIVATE) wrapping ATTACK_REACTION — neither is a condition, and the empty-OR bug hid both. UNIMPLEMENTED: there is no trigger for "when an opponent plays or activates an attack reaction", so this now approximates it with the opponent-attack check.
